<translate>
<!--T:6-->
'''Goten''' is one of the Buu Saga fighters of the [[Special:MyLanguage/Otherworld Tournament|Otherworld Tournament]], drawn either in his base form or as a Super Saiyan. He is also a story opponent in the [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] and the [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]], where he turns Super Saiyan in the middle of the fight.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the tournament == <!--T:7-->

<!--T:8-->
Goten can be drawn as a '''contender''' in the Otherworld Tournament. Each contender seat draws a random fighter from the Buu Saga cast, and a tournament never has two forms of the same character, so it has at most one Goten: base or Super Saiyan. The draw is revealed once everybody accepts the rules, and you only face him if he reaches your bout: fights between two NPCs are decided automatically.

<!--T:9-->
His stats come from the tournament, not from the character: each contender draw has its own health, damage and AI tier. By default they range from 238,000 health, 9,900 melee damage and 8,840 ki damage (Smart AI) to 612,500 health, 25,800 melee damage and 23,460 ki damage (Elite AI), and contenders get 8% stronger for every round already played.

<!--T:10-->
Tournament fighters never transform: Goten keeps the form he was drawn in for the whole bout. Bouts end at knockout, so he isn't killed and drops nothing.
</translate>

<translate>
== Behavior and abilities == <!--T:11-->

<!--T:12-->
Goten is child-sized and flies. His AI tier comes from the tournament draw or, in story quests, from your difficulty (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Sagas#Enemy AI tiers|enemy AI tiers]]). Both forms backstep away from your hits; the rest of his kit depends on the form:
</translate>
{| class="wikitable"

|-
| <translate><!--T:17--> Base</translate> || <translate><!--T:18--> Kamehameha</translate> || <translate><!--T:19--> Aerial Combo</translate> || <translate><!--T:20--> Backsteps</translate>
|-
| <translate><!--T:21--> Super Saiyan</translate> || <translate><!--T:22--> Kamehameha, Ki Volley</translate> || <translate><!--T:23--> Melee Combo</translate> || <translate><!--T:24--> Backsteps; teleports behind you</translate>
|}

<translate>
== Forms == <!--T:25-->

<!--T:26-->
Goten has two forms, each a separate entity: '''Goten''' (base) and '''Goten (Super Saiyan)'''. In the tournament each form is drawn on its own and stays as it is. In story quests he starts in his base form and turns Super Saiyan partway through the fight.
</translate>

<translate>
== In the story == <!--T:28-->

<!--T:29-->
Goten is fought in three story quests. In all of them he starts in his base form and, by default at half health, turns Super Saiyan and comes back at full health with stronger stats.

<!--T:30-->
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Buu Saga|Buu Saga]] quest 1, ''Train with Goten and Gohan'', on the plains, together with Gohan.
* Buu Saga quest 5, ''Tournament: Goten'', on the plains.
* [[Special:MyLanguage/Movies Saga|Movies Saga]] quest 31, ''Goten and Trunks'', in the snowy plains, together with [[Special:MyLanguage/Kid Trunks|Trunks]].

<!--T:31-->
The adult Goten of the [[Special:MyLanguage/GT Saga|GT Saga]] is a separate entity.
</translate>
